hook: Most money mistakes don't come from bad luck, they come from bad ideas that sound like common sense. In this video I break 20 money myths from three angles: the math (cash, houses, Social Security, tax refunds), the mindset (luck, budgets, frugality) and the playbook (credit cards, debt, investing).
